facts.fact: The article says Cote d'Ivoire inaugurated in October 2025 at Grand-Bassam (VITIB technology free zone) a 4,000 m2 sovereign data centre run by ST Digital with OVHcloud, meant to let firms and administrations host data locally; no Tier rating is given.

note: Cybastion state data centre is only authorised and financed, not built.
